title: weierstrass-delaunay: code and formal proofs for the Weierstrass-Delaunay cell decomposition of genus-two and hyperelliptic moduli spaces
description: Code and formal proofs accompanying a series of papers on the Weierstrass-Delaunay cell decomposition of the moduli space of genus-two Riemann surfaces and of the hyperelliptic locus in every genus. Contents: a Lean 4 formalization of the classification of six-vertex sphere triangulations, their automorphism groups and the Whitehead-move orbit (Paper 1); a verification script reproducing every enumeration of Paper 1; and a script that enumerates all realizable Delaunay cells of the hyperelliptic locus and checks the orbifold Euler characteristic and rational homology of the resulting cell complex in genus 2 and 3 (Paper 5).
